package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

func SaveArticles(ctx context.Context, backend db.Mutator) error {
	created := models.Article{Title: "Generated key"}
	if err := models.ArticleObjects.Save(ctx, backend, &created); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	explicitZero := models.NewArticleWithID(0)
	explicitZero.Title = "Explicit zero key"
	if err := models.ArticleObjects.Save(
		ctx,
		backend,
		&explicitZero,
		models.ArticleUpdateFields(models.ArticleFields.Title, models.ArticleFields.Published),
	); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := models.ArticleObjects.Save(ctx, backend, &explicitZero, models.ArticleUpdateFields()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := models.ArticleObjects.Save(ctx, backend, &explicitZero, models.ArticleUpdateFieldNames("title")); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := models.ArticleObjects.Save(ctx, backend, &explicitZero, models.ArticleForceUpdate()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return models.ArticleObjects.Save(ctx, backend, &created, models.ArticleForceInsert())
}

var generatedEmptyMask orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = models.ArticleUpdateFields()
var generatedEmptyNames orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = models.ArticleUpdateFieldNames()
var generatedForceInsert orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = models.ArticleForceInsert()
var generatedForceUpdate orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = models.ArticleForceUpdate()
var genericTypedMask orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = orm.UpdateFields(models.ArticleFields.Title)
var genericEmptyMask orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = orm.UpdateFields[models.Article]()
var genericNames orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = orm.UpdateFieldNames[models.Article]("title")
var genericForceInsert orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = orm.ForceInsert[models.Article]()
var genericForceUpdate orm.SaveOption[models.Article] = orm.ForceUpdate[models.Article]()
